scope: LEGO / interlocking bricks for AI research

resources.title: LEGO-Puzzles: How Good Are MLLMs at Multi-Step Spatial Reasoning?

description.en: Tests spatial understanding and multi-step assembly planning. A natural starting evaluation for MLLMs.
description.zh: 评测空间理解与多步搭建规划，适合作为多模态模型的起点评测。

dataset.name: LEGO-Puzzles
dataset.scale: Elementary: 1,100 questions / 11 tasks; Planning: see paper version
dataset.access_en: Hugging Face; match the downloaded release to the evaluated paper version.
dataset.access_zh: Hugging Face；下载版本须与所采用论文版本对应。

resources.title: TPRU: Advancing Temporal and Procedural Understanding in Large Multimodal Models

description.en: Multi-domain temporal reasoning with a LEGO assembly subset; studies ordering, next-frame prediction and previous-frame review.
description.zh: 包含 LEGO 装配子集的多领域时序推理工作，覆盖排序、下一帧预测与前序帧回溯。

notes.en: The 24,750 training examples are the full multi-domain set, not 24,750 LEGO examples.
notes.zh: 24,750 是多领域训练集总量，不是 LEGO 子集大小。

dataset.name: TPRU-25k / TPRU-test
dataset.access_en: Hugging Face; LEGO source: 36 Arvin Bricks stop-motion videos, as reported in the paper.
dataset.access_zh: Hugging Face；论文注明 LEGO 源材料为 Arvin Bricks 的 36 个定格动画视频。

resources.title: LEGO Co-builder: Exploring Fine-Grained Vision-Language Modeling for Multimodal LEGO Assembly Assistants

description.en: Studies fine-grained instruction following and state recognition in stepwise LEGO scenes.
description.zh: 研究分步 LEGO 场景中的细粒度指令遵循与状态识别。

notes.en: Author-linked repository exists, but its README is minimal; dataset packaging and reproduction steps need clarification.
notes.zh: 作者链接的仓库存在，但 README 很简略；数据打包方式和复现步骤仍需核实。

resources.title: Brick-Composer: Using MLLMs for Assembly with Diverse Bricks

description.en: BC-Bench separates brick selection from pose prediction; training combines human designs, simulator feedback and synthetic trajectories.
description.zh: BC-Bench 将选砖与位姿预测分开评测，结合人类设计、仿真反馈和合成轨迹训练。

notes.en: Repository title: “MLLMs Construct Everything from Building Blocks”; this is the same project, not a second paper.
notes.zh: 仓库使用标题“MLLMs Construct Everything from Building Blocks”，与此条为同一项目。

dataset.name: BC-Bench / Brick-Composer assets
dataset.modality: Manual renders + brick selection + 6-DoF pose / trajectories
dataset.scale: See release splits; designer supervision covers 102 human-designed objects
dataset.access_en: Hugging Face links in the official repository; confirm the benchmark split separately.
dataset.access_zh: 官方仓库提供 Hugging Face 入口；需单独确认 benchmark 的划分。

resources.title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design

description.en: Evaluates text-guided coding agents under model, full-set and fixed-inventory building constraints.
description.zh: 评测文本驱动的编程智能体，覆盖小模型、整套搭建与限定零件库存。

dataset.name: BrickBench prompts / runs
dataset.modality: Text prompts + generated assemblies / agent runs
dataset.access_en: Prompts in BrickAgent; run artifacts on Hugging Face.
dataset.access_zh: 题目在 BrickAgent 仓库；运行产物在 Hugging Face。

resources.title: DailyBrick: Language-Guided Synthesis of Brick Assembly Instructions

description.en: An agentic pipeline generates a brick model and executable stepwise assembly instructions, with review and repair.
description.zh: 通过智能体流程生成积木模型与可执行的逐砖说明书，并进行审查和修复。

notes.en: SpatialAgentLab project. The public website repository is not a verified implementation or dataset release.
notes.zh: SpatialAgentLab 项目；公开项目网页仓库不等于算法代码或数据已发布。

resources.title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds

description.en: Equips pretrained agents with the BrickLayer assembly API and a physical-feasibility validator.
description.zh: 为预训练智能体提供 BrickLayer 搭建 API 与物理可行性检查器。

notes.en: Its validator-defined feasibility should not be equated with proof of arbitrary real-robot executability.
notes.zh: 检查器定义的物理可行性不能直接等同于任意真实机器人都可执行。

resources.title: BrickNet: Graph-Backed Generative Brick Assembly

description.en: Generates assemblies using connectivity-based representations over diverse real part types.
description.zh: 采用基于连接关系的表示，生成包含多种真实零件类型的积木结构。

dataset.name: BrickNet
dataset.access_en: Dataset access is gated by a request form; code and some part assets are public.
dataset.access_zh: 数据需要通过表单申请；代码和部分零件资产公开。

resources.title: Generating Physically Stable and Buildable Brick Structures from Text (BrickGPT / LegoGPT)

description.en: Autoregressive text-to-brick generation with validity checks and physics-aware rollback.
description.zh: 通过自回归模型、合法性检查和物理约束回退，实现文本到积木结构生成。

notes.en: LegoGPT / StableText2Lego are earlier names of BrickGPT / StableText2Brick; do not double-count them.
notes.zh: LegoGPT / StableText2Lego 是 BrickGPT / StableText2Brick 的早期名称，不重复计数。

dataset.name: StableText2Brick (formerly StableText2Lego)
dataset.access_en: Hugging Face; official code links models and generation pipeline.
dataset.access_zh: Hugging Face；官方代码仓库提供模型和生成流程入口。

resources.title: TreeSBA: Tree-Transformer for Self-Supervised Sequential Brick Assembly

description.en: Uses a tree representation and silhouette self-supervision to infer assembly sequences from multiview images.
description.zh: 利用树表示与轮廓自监督，从多视角图像预测搭建序列。

resources.title: Brick-by-Brick: Combinatorial Construction with Deep Reinforcement Learning

description.en: Learns sequential brick placement from target images while filtering invalid actions.
description.zh: 从目标图像学习逐砖放置，并筛除非法动作。

resources.title: Image2Lego: Customized LEGO Set Generation from Images

description.en: Reconstructs a voxel representation from an image, then converts it into a brick layout and instructions.
description.zh: 从图像预测体素表示，再转换为积木布局与搭建说明。

resources.title: Building LEGO Using Deep Generative Models of Graphs

description.en: An early graph-generative approach to learning brick structures from human designs.
description.zh: 从人类设计中学习积木结构的早期图生成模型。

resources.title: Combinatorial 3D Shape Generation via Sequential Assembly

description.en: Uses Bayesian optimization to choose sequential placements under geometric and stability objectives.
description.zh: 利用贝叶斯优化，在几何和稳定性目标下选择顺序放置动作。

dataset.name: Combinatorial 3D Shape Dataset
dataset.access_en: Dataset and generation scripts are included in the repository.
dataset.access_zh: 仓库内包含数据目录与生成脚本。

resources.title: Legolization: Optimizing LEGO Designs

description.en: Optimizes brick layouts using force-based stability analysis; foundational geometry-to-brick work.
description.zh: 使用基于受力的稳定性分析优化积木布局，是几何模型转积木的重要早期工作。

resources.title: Translating a Visual LEGO Manual to a Machine-Executable Plan (MEPNet)

description.en: Recovers component poses and assembly steps from illustrated manuals.
description.zh: 从图解说明书恢复零件位姿与装配步骤。

dataset.name: MEPNet LEGO manual datasets
dataset.scale: Three LEGO manual datasets; see paper
dataset.access_en: Repository links training, validation and evaluation archives on SharePoint; archives not downloaded here.
dataset.access_zh: 仓库链接 SharePoint 上的训练、验证与评测数据；本次未下载完整压缩包。

resources.title: Break and Make: Interactive Structural Understanding Using LEGO Bricks

description.en: Introduces LTRON: inspect and disassemble a structure, then reconstruct it through low-level actions.
description.zh: 提出 LTRON：先观察并拆解结构，再使用低层动作重建。

notes.en: Use the paper-specific release; the master README warns about unstable development and non-public dependencies.
notes.zh: 复现应使用对应论文版本；master 的 README 提醒开发版不稳定且存在非公开依赖。

dataset.name: LTRON / Break and Make
dataset.scale: Complex models with over 1,000 distinct brick shapes in the paper
dataset.access_en: Install assets through LTRON; pin the release associated with the paper.
dataset.access_zh: 通过 LTRON 获取资产；固定与论文对应的版本。

resources.title: Learning to Build by Building Your Own Instructions (InstructioNet)

description.en: Stores visual instructions during disassembly to support longer-horizon reconstruction.
description.zh: 在拆解时保存视觉说明书，支持更长序列的重建。

dataset.name: LTRON procedural vehicles
dataset.access_en: Use LTRON v1.1.0 and the eccv-24 training branch.
dataset.access_zh: 使用 LTRON v1.1.0 与 eccv-24 训练分支。

resources.title: SCANet: Correcting LEGO Assembly Errors with Self-Correct Assembly Network

description.en: Detects incorrect components and predicts assembly corrections from manual images.
description.zh: 依据说明书图像检测错装零件并预测修正。

notes.en: The former project website returned 404; use the official supplement repository and video. Its README Code link points to an MP4, so it is not counted as a verified implementation.
notes.zh: 旧项目网站返回 404，改用官方补充仓库和演示视频。其 README 的 Code 链接实际指向 MP4，因此不标记为已核实的算法实现。

dataset.name: LEGO-ECA
dataset.access_en: Official supplement repository links Google Drive / Baidu archives; not downloaded here.
dataset.access_zh: 官方补充仓库提供 Google Drive / 百度网盘；本次未下载完整数据。

resources.title: Planning Assembly Sequence with Graph Transformer

description.en: Represents LEGO assemblies as heterogeneous graphs and predicts construction order.
description.zh: 将 LEGO 装配表示为异构图并预测搭建顺序。

resources.title: Physics-Aware Combinatorial Assembly Sequence Planning using Data-free Action Masking

description.en: Reinforcement learning with online physical action masks for executable construction plans.
description.zh: 利用在线物理动作掩码约束强化学习，规划可执行搭建序列。

resources.title: StableLego: Stability Analysis of Block Stacking Assembly

description.en: Analyzes force balance and structural stability; useful for evaluating generated designs.
description.zh: 分析受力平衡与结构稳定性，可用于检查生成的搭建方案。

notes.en: The implementation uses Gurobi; code availability alone does not guarantee a ready-to-run environment.
notes.zh: 实现依赖 Gurobi；有代码不代表环境可直接运行。

dataset.name: StableLego
dataset.modality: Voxel grids + assembly JSON + stability scores
dataset.access_en: Download link in official repository; includes stable and unstable examples.
dataset.access_zh: 官方仓库提供下载入口，包含稳定与不稳定结构样本。

resources.title: WorkBenchMark: A LEGO-Based Assembly Benchmark with an Assembly-by-Disassembly Baseline for the Smart Manufacturing League

description.en: A Duplo assembly benchmark connecting perception, symbolic planning and manipulation.
description.zh: 连接感知、符号规划与操作的 Duplo 装配基准。

dataset.name: WorkBenchMark
dataset.modality: YAML task specifications + hidden ground truth
dataset.access_en: Task files are public; do not expose ground_truth to the solver.
dataset.access_zh: 任务文件已公开；ground_truth 仅供评测，不能作为求解器输入。

resources.title: BrickSim: A Physics-Based Simulator for Manipulating Interlocking Brick Assemblies

description.en: Simulates interlocking brick manipulation; a useful environment for assembly, disassembly and teleoperation.
description.zh: 仿真咬合积木的操作，可用于装配、拆卸与遥操作研究。

notes.en: Current upstream quickstart targets x86-64 Linux and NVIDIA / Isaac Sim. No local simulator installation was attempted.
notes.zh: 当前官方快速入门面向 x86-64 Linux 与 NVIDIA / Isaac Sim；本次没有在本机安装仿真器。

resources.title: APEX-MR: Multi-Robot Asynchronous Planning and Execution for Cooperative Assembly

description.en: Coordinates multiple robots asynchronously for cooperative assembly.
description.zh: 通过异步规划与执行协调多个机器人协作装配。

resources.title: Eye-in-Finger: Smart Fingers for Delicate Assembly and Disassembly of LEGO

description.en: Studies sensor-equipped fingers for precise brick insertion and removal.
description.zh: 研究面向精密积木插接与拆卸的传感手指。

resources.title: Robotic LEGO Assembly and Disassembly from Human Demonstration

description.en: Learns assembly and disassembly from demonstrations and validates execution using a digital twin.
description.zh: 从人类演示学习装配与拆卸，并用数字孪生验证执行。

resources.title: MobileBrick: Building LEGO for 3D Reconstruction on Mobile Devices

description.en: Mobile RGB-D observations paired with precise geometry for fine-scale reconstruction.
description.zh: 移动设备 RGB-D 观测与精确几何配对，用于精细三维重建。

dataset.name: MobileBrick
dataset.modality: RGB-D + camera poses + masks + ground-truth mesh
dataset.access_en: Download via official project / repository; reconstruction data, not an assembly-action corpus.
dataset.access_zh: 通过官方项目页／仓库下载；这是重建数据，并非装配动作语料。

resources.title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction

description.en: Infers part poses from an image and a given part inventory using SE(3) flow and connectivity guidance.
description.zh: 给定图像与零件集合，利用 SE(3) 流模型和连接引导推断零件位姿。

dataset.name: BrickFlow
dataset.access_en: Data and model entry points are linked by the official project.
dataset.access_zh: 官方项目链接数据与模型入口。

resources.title: Photos and rendered images of LEGO bricks

description.en: A data descriptor for real and synthetic part images, with part identity and category labels.
description.zh: 记录真实照片和合成零件图像的数据论文，包含零件身份与类别标签。

dataset.name: Photos and rendered images of LEGO bricks
dataset.modality: Real photos + renders + part labels / detection subsets
dataset.scale: Approximately 155,000 photos + 1.5 million renders across the collection
dataset.access_en: Follow the individual dataset DOIs in the paper; Most Wiedzy may require a normal browser challenge.
dataset.access_zh: 按论文中各子数据集 DOI 获取；Most Wiedzy 可能需要浏览器验证。

resources.title: B200C LEGO Classification Dataset

description.en: Synthetic part-classification images with randomized context, lighting and occlusions.
description.zh: 带随机场景、光照和遮挡的合成零件分类图像。

notes.en: The author repository documents the dataset, but the Kaggle URL returned 404 to HEAD and only a script-rendered shell in the web reader; download availability remains unresolved.
notes.zh: 作者仓库记录了该数据集，但 Kaggle 入口对 HEAD 返回 404，网页读取仅得到脚本页面；当前下载可用性尚未确认。

dataset.name: B200C
dataset.access_en: Author-linked Kaggle page; current download availability not confirmed.
dataset.access_zh: 作者提供 Kaggle 链接；当前能否下载尚未确认。

resources.title: Video of LEGO bricks on conveyor belt

description.en: Real conveyor-belt videos for part recognition and sorting research.
description.zh: 用于零件识别与分拣研究的真实传送带视频。

notes.en: Automated access met an anti-bot page during this review; download availability was not confirmed.
notes.zh: 本次自动访问遇到反爬页面，未确认能否完成数据下载。

dataset.name: Conveyor-belt videos
dataset.access_en: Institutional catalog; browser verification may be required.
dataset.access_zh: 机构目录，可能需要浏览器验证。

resources.title: Lego Project Data Archive

description.en: Research archive of collaborative LEGO puzzle activity with audiovisual and 360-degree material.
description.zh: 协作 LEGO 拼图活动的研究档案，包含音视频与 360 度材料。

dataset.name: Lego Project Data Archive
dataset.access_en: University record links Zenodo; designed for interaction research, not brick-pose labels.
dataset.access_zh: 大学记录链接 Zenodo；用于交互研究，不提供逐砖位姿标注的保证。

resources.title: LDraw Official Model Repository (OMR)

description.en: Community reconstructions of LEGO sets in an interoperable CAD format.
description.zh: 以通用 CAD 格式发布的社区 LEGO 套装重建模型。

dataset.name: LDraw OMR
dataset.access_en: Browse model records and per-file terms; models are not automatically validated action trajectories.
dataset.access_zh: 按模型记录和文件条款使用；模型不自动等于已验证动作轨迹。

resources.title: Rebrickable downloads and API

description.en: Structured part, color, set and inventory metadata for joining CAD, manuals and video set IDs.
description.zh: 提供零件、颜色、套装和库存元数据，可连接 CAD、说明书与视频套装编号。

notes.en: Automated browser access was blocked during review; download endpoints and current terms need a manual check.
notes.zh: 本次自动浏览访问受阻，具体下载入口和当前条款需人工核对。

dataset.name: Rebrickable catalog
dataset.access_en: Catalog / API, not an annotated vision dataset.
dataset.access_zh: 目录／API，并非带标注的视觉数据集。

resources.title: LEGO official building instructions

description.en: Set-number lookup for original instruction booklets and step references.
description.zh: 按套装编号查找原版说明书和步骤参考。

dataset.name: Official building instructions
dataset.access_en: Official lookup portal; public viewing is separate from redistribution or training permission.
dataset.access_zh: 官方检索入口；公开阅读与再分发／训练授权应分开确认。

resources.title: LDraw parts library and file format

description.en: Core geometry and interchange format for digital brick pipelines.
description.zh: 数字积木流程的基础零件几何库与交换格式。

resources.title: LeoCAD

description.en: Open-source LDraw-compatible editor for creating and inspecting brick models.
description.zh: 开源且兼容 LDraw 的积木模型编辑与检查工具。

resources.title: BrickLink Studio

description.en: Desktop brick-design tool and instruction authoring ecosystem.
description.zh: 桌面积木设计工具与说明书制作生态。

notes.en: The site redirected to a maintenance notice on 2026-11-22. Recheck before installation.
notes.zh: 2026-11-22 访问跳转到维护公告，安装前需重新确认。

resources.title: LPub3D

description.en: Creates LEGO-style digital building instructions from LDraw models.
description.zh: 基于 LDraw 模型制作 LEGO 风格数字搭建说明书。

resources.title: ImportLDraw for Blender

description.en: Imports LDraw parts and models into Blender for rendering.
description.zh: 将 LDraw 零件和模型导入 Blender 进行渲染。

notes.en: Check supported Blender versions before building a rendering pipeline.
notes.zh: 搭建渲染流水线前先核对兼容的 Blender 版本。

resources.title: BrickNet-Render

description.en: Converts LDraw assemblies into Blender scenes for batch rendering.
description.zh: 将 LDraw 装配模型转换为 Blender 场景，用于批量渲染。

resources.title: BrickRenderer

description.en: Renders realistic training images of individual LDraw pieces.
description.zh: 为 LDraw 零件渲染较真实的训练图像。

resources.title: LegoTrainingRenderer

description.en: Blender/Python utilities for RGB renders, masks and normals of LEGO structures.
description.zh: 生成 LEGO 结构 RGB 图像、掩码和法线的 Blender／Python 工具。

resources.title: VLMEvalKit LEGO-Puzzles integration

description.en: A common evaluation harness; LEGO-Puzzles documents its LEGO dataset entry.
description.zh: 通用多模态评测框架，LEGO-Puzzles 官方文档给出了 LEGO 数据集入口。

resources.title: Classifying LEGO Bricks with Machine Learning — Piotr Rybak

description.en: EuroPython talk covering dataset construction, classification, detection and metric learning.
description.zh: EuroPython 演讲，涵盖数据构建、分类、检测与度量学习。

resources.title: The WORLD’S FIRST Universal LEGO Sorting Machine — Daniel West

description.en: Creator demonstration of an AI-based part sorter.
description.zh: 创作者展示基于 AI 的积木零件分拣机。

resources.title: LEGO Sorter AI: How Does It Work? — Daniel West

description.en: Creator explanation of the visual-recognition pipeline behind the sorter.
description.zh: 创作者解释分拣机背后的视觉识别流程。

resources.title: AustrianBrickFan

description.en: Speed-build channel: a candidate source for studying visual construction sequences, after checking each video.
description.zh: 搭建速录频道，可逐条筛选用于研究视觉搭建序列的视频。

notes.en: A viewing/source-discovery link, not a pre-cleared training dataset. Speedups and edits can hide actions.
notes.zh: 用于观看和发现视频来源，不是已授权训练数据集；加速与剪辑可能隐藏动作。

resources.title: Brickognize

description.en: Visual part identification application; the author talk provides technical context.
description.zh: 视觉零件识别应用，作者演讲提供技术背景。

notes.en: JavaScript application; included as a product reference, not an open model release.
notes.zh: JavaScript 应用；作为产品参考收录，不标作开放模型。

resources.title: Brickit

description.en: Scans a pile of bricks and proposes builds using the observed inventory.
description.zh: 扫描散落积木，并依据识别出的库存推荐搭建方案。

notes.en: Product reference; no public training-data release is asserted.
notes.zh: 产品参考，不据此声称其训练数据已公开。

resources.title: Awesome LEGO Machine Learning

description.en: The inspiration for this list, especially its recognition, sorting and rendering coverage.
description.zh: 本仓库的结构参考，尤其是零件识别、分拣与渲染部分。

resources.title: Awesome LEGO

description.en: A broader community index covering the LEGO software and hobby ecosystem.
description.zh: 覆盖 LEGO 软件与爱好者生态的综合社区索引。

resources.title: Awesome Brick Assembly Robot Creativity

description.en: A complementary research list focused on brick assembly and robotic creativity.
description.zh: 聚焦积木装配与机器人创造力的补充研究清单。
